project: PAX Hotel TV for LG webOS

tasks.name: Project Setup & Metadata
tasks.description: Configure appinfo.json with 1920x1080 resolution, permissions, requiredACG, icons and directory layout

tasks.name: Assets Mirroring
tasks.description: Copy icons, logos, weather assets, and background wallpapers from Hotel_TV_App & tv_templates

tasks.name: API Client & Storage Service
tasks.description: Build Laravel API client (/login, /generate-pair-code, /pair-status, /check-version) with retry and localStorage caching

tasks.name: webOS Device & Luna Service Adapter
tasks.description: Integrate webOSTV.js SDK, Luna services for network info, time sync, and app launching with browser fallbacks

tasks.name: LG Remote D-Pad Navigation Engine
tasks.description: Implement complete spatial navigation for webOS remote (Arrows, OK:13, Back:461, Colors:403-406, Numbers:0-9)

tasks.name: Screen 1: TV Pairing & Authentication Screen
tasks.description: 1:1 clone of TvLoginScreen with QR Code (180s timer + polling) and Sign In with Remote (Form + on-screen keypad)

tasks.name: Screen 2: Main Hotel TV Dashboard
tasks.description: Top Header (clock, logo, room, weather), ambient wallpaper slider, bottom category menu carousel

tasks.name: Screen 3: Sub-Screens & Modals
tasks.description: Live TV (HLS streaming player), Hotel Info, Amenities, Room Info, Applications (OTT), Flights, Weather, Languages, Settings

tasks.name: Screen 4: Inactivity Screensaver
tasks.description: 2-minute idle trigger, animated slide-up, rotating amenity wallpapers, digital clock, wake-on-key

tasks.name: Deterministic Verification & Packaging Check
tasks.description: Zero JS syntax errors, complete remote D-pad focus verification, API contract check, and ares packaging instructions
